name: Sequence Diagram — OAuth2 Login Flow
description: Sequence Diagram describes the time-ordered interaction between User, Frontend, Auth Server, Resource Server and Database in the OAuth2 authentication flow. This diagram answers: who calls whom, in what order, and what response is received.
purpose: Detailed technical design for the OAuth2 flow and backend documentation.
useCases: Identify lifelines: User, Frontend, Auth Server, Resource Server, Database
Describe messages in order: POST /login, validate credentials, return JWT
Add combined fragment: alt valid/invalid password
requirements: REQ-001: User enters email and password on the login form
REQ-002: Frontend sends POST /login to Auth Server
REQ-003: Auth Server checks credentials in Database
REQ-004: If valid, create and return JWT token
REQ-005: Frontend stores token and redirects to dashboard

elements.name: User
elements.description: User who wants to log in
